title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: Hessian矩阵的“放气”：多模态扩散Transformer的秩为4的W4A4量化

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的量化方法，通过低秩分支分解提高4位权重-激活量化的效果。 In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present \method{}, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a \emph{deflated Hessian} that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 \method{} consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 \method{} improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50\% to 68.17\% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, \method{} achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种新的量化方法，通过低秩分支分解提升4位权重-激活量化的效果。在扩散变换器中，低秩分支可通过将每个权重分解为低比特残差和高精度的低秩分量，缓解4位权重-激活（W4A4）训练后量化（PTQ）带来的损失。 然而，现有的低秩PTQ方法要么分别优化低秩补偿和残差量化，通常需要更高的秩；要么依赖二阶权重更新，但未显式建模激活量化误差，而在4位量化下这一问题尤为显著。 为应对这些局限性，我们提出了 \method{}——一个统一框架，它将低秩辅助的W4A4 PTQ建模为耦合校准问题，并从联合目标函数中推导出基于优化的求解器。 消除输出端的低秩因子可得到一个“压缩后的海森矩阵”，从而降低低秩分量已捕获的残差误差影响；同时，框架还引入了激活噪声代理以抑制激活量化误差。 在五种扩散模型主干上，秩为4的 \method{} 在PSNR和LPIPS指标上均持续优于秩为4的SVDQuant。 在SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell和FLUX.1-dev上，\method{} 进一步超越了秩为32的SVDQuant，其秩小$8\times$，量化速度最快可达$6.25\times$。 此外，在Qwen3-8B大语言模型上，秩为4的 \method{} 使MMLU准确率从61.50\%提升至68.17\%，优于秩为32的SVDQuant。 总体而言，\method{} 以显著更低的秩和量化成本实现了更优的W4A4性能。
